name: garmin-connect-personal-api-mcp
description: Self-hosted MCP server for the Garmin Connect Personal API on Cloudflare Workers.
author: Hannu Tapanila

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p test && tsc -p test/worker && tsc -p scripts
scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test

GARMIN_API_KEY.description: Garmin Connect Personal API key. Create it in Garmin Connect on the web under **Personal API Key**. It is shown only once and expires (30 days – 1 year).

OWNER_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase you enter once when connecting an MCP client (at least 16 characters; changing it signs out every connected app). Generate a strong one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and keep it in a password manager.

OAUTH_KV.description: KV namespace for OAuth clients, grants and tokens.

GARMIN_KV.description: KV namespace for the cached Garmin access token, failed sign-in counters and small caches.
